recommendation_summary: Keep the existing workbook and add a Counter sheet with one input cell that uses XLOOKUP to return the shelf location and price for a typed part code.

labels.Requirements and who asked: Requirements and who asked: You asked to look up shelf and price 40 times/day on the counter laptop while Excel stays the authoritative list.
labels.Deleted: Deleted: Retool, Supabase, Next.js portal, hosted database, sync, and multi-user access.
labels.Bottleneck: Bottleneck: Scrolling 240 rows to find each code at the counter.
labels.Checked myself: Checked myself: You told me single laptop with Excel, 240 unique codes, read-only lookup, you update it directly.

note: All four labelled lines come before a single in-workbook XLOOKUP recommendation, and the deleted stack is never reoffered.
